senses.sense_definition: The state or quality of two or more things combining in a way that enhances or emphasizes the qualities of each other.

examples.text: The <w>complementarity</w> of their skills made them an incredibly effective team for the project.
There is a natural <w>complementarity</w> between the two departments that improves overall company performance.

senses.sense_definition: A principle in quantum physics stating that objects can exhibit mutually exclusive properties, such as wave and particle behavior, depending on the experimental setup.

examples.text: Niels Bohr introduced the concept of <w>complementarity</w> to explain the dual nature of light.
In quantum mechanics, <w>complementarity</w> suggests that certain physical properties cannot be measured at the same time.

senses.sense_definition: A linguistic relationship where two words are binary opposites, meaning the negation of one necessarily implies the affirmation of the other.

examples.text: The pair dead and alive is a classic example of <w>complementarity</w> in semantics.
Linguists study <w>complementarity</w> to understand how binary antonyms function in a language.
